{{RemovedSandboxOnly|date=5th of June 2026}}{{For|other uses of [[Soul (Disambiguation)|Soul]]}} {{SameName|Soul Stealer|[[Soul Stealer (Legacy)|Legacy]] • [[Soul Stealer|Modern]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Soul Stealer |image1 = SoulStealer.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Hardcore Mode|{{Color|HardcoreMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 45 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]16,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (2.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Soul Steal}}''' - The '''Soul Stealer''' attacks one tower using its axe, spawning one [[Soul]] from the attacked tower and giving it an 150% [[Fatigue Debuff]] (60% increase). }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Soul Stealer''' was an [[enemy]] that only appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health, but walks quite slowly. Its main ability is to attack towers with its axe. It swings its axe at a random nearby tower, which spawns one [[Soul]] from it and applies a 150% [[Fatigue Debuff]]. ==Appearance== The '''Soul Stealer''' has glowing pink arms and its head is purple. It wears a black dominus with purple horns and is faceless. It wears diamond-plated black armor and pauldrons, with a pink gem on its chestplate, and purple gauntlets on both arms, both with a pink gem. Its torso, legs, and boots are granite purple. Purple particles are emitted from its boots and gauntlets, and pink particles are emitted from its arms. It wields a black axe with a wrapped handle and a purple outline near its cutting edge. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Soul Stealer''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *The '''Soul Stealer''' should not usually be too much of a problem. **However, be aware that they will usually spawn in pairs or threes, making them a little more difficult to deal with. *The [[Ranger]] can make light work of these [[enemies]]. The [[Commander]] is recommended to boost the firerate of the [[Ranger]] to try and defeat the '''Soul Stealer''' as quickly as possible. **While the [[Ranger]] is immune to stuns, it is not immune to the [[Fatigue Debuff]] applied by the '''Soul Stealer'''. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]], can be great against the '''Soul Stealer'''. **The [[Turret]] can be especially useful against the '''Soul Stealer''', as it is not affected by its [[Fatigue Debuff]] and it does not spawn any [[Soul]]. **The [[Engineer]] can also be very useful, as the '''Soul Stealer''' cannot attack its sentries or damage them. It can however make it so it takes longer for [[Engineer]] to get enough scrap required to build a sentry. *Try not to place towers near the start of the path, or close to it, if you can. **This makes them a target for the '''Soul Stealer''' to spawn a [[Soul]] from and increase their firerate. ***If any towers are hit by the '''Soul Stealer''', the [[Commander]] can mitigate some of the effects. *The [[Military Base]] can be used against the '''Soul Stealer''' as its [[units]] cannot be attacked. *Any stalling tower can be used to slow the '''Soul Stealer''' down as it has no immunities. **Be aware that, due to its large size, it can only be stunned by the [[Warden]] and frozen by freezing towers for a shorter period of time compared to an average-sized enemy. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SoulStealerWalk.gif|Walking animation (29 October 2020 – Present) SoulStealerSwing.gif|''Soul Steal'' animation (29 October 2020 – Present) DeadStealer.gif|Removed death animation (29 October 2020 – 12 March 2022) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSoulStealer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2020|'''Soul Stealer''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexSoulStealer.png|'''Soul Stealer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Soul Stealer''' was considered a major boss during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] due to a bug. *Before the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]], if the '''Soul Stealer''' used its ability on a tower, the [[Soul]] spawned from the tower will be the "''Tower's [[Soul]]''" with the tower's name being the one that the [[Soul]] spawned from, instead of "'''Soul Stealer's''' [[Soul]]". *The axe used by the '''Soul Stealer''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|93536785|Zombie Axe}} gear from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Soul Stealer''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **{{Bug}} ''Soul Steal'' ability can spawn [[Soul]]s from a tower even if it is not a humanoid. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **Death animation removed. **{{Bug}} '''Soul Stealer''' gets permanently stuck after using its ''Soul Steal'' ability. **{{Bugfix}} '''Soul Stealer''' can no longer spawn a [[Soul]] from a tower that is not a humanoid. *'''16 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]d **{{Bugfix}} '''Soul Stealer''' no longer gets permanently stuck after using its ''Soul Steal'' ability. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **{{Bug}} Summons an invisible [[Soul]] in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode when there is no [[Legacy]] modifier applied. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Soul Stealer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] & [[Molten Boss]]|Wave 44|Soul Stealer, [[Health Cultist]], [[Soul]], [[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]] & [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]]|Wave 45|[[Fallen]], [[Soul Boss]] & [[Necromancer Boss]]|Wave 46|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Soul Stealer}}
